title: Purrconomy: a cozy idle cat game built with Claude Code, with all the in-game art and music made by code
author: DVSoftware
selftext:
Hi all. I just released Purrconomy on Android, and iOS is coming soon. It's an idle game about one black cat and the room she rules. You pet her for purrs, the crankier she gets the more each pet is worth, and every cat you adopt moves into the room where you can see it.



Here's where AI was and wasn't used:

\- Code: Claude Code wrote nearly all of it, about 1.9 MB of JavaScript, plus the mobile app shell, the Firebase backend and the test tools. My job was deciding what to build, playing it, and sending it back when something was off.

\- In-game art: no image model and no image files. Everything in the room is drawn on a canvas by code, and the app icon comes from the same renderer.

\- Music: also code. The game composes its own café jazz with WebAudio, with no samples and no music model.

\- Store art: this part is AI. Some of the store graphics were painted with an image model.

\- Trailer (attached): real footage of the game with its own music.



What helped most:

\- A long written spec, now about 4,000 lines. Every change goes into it, so a new session doesn't start from zero.

\- Thousands of automated checks, plus a pixel diff that shows when a change alters the picture.



What was harder:

\- Taste stayed my job. One of the first notes I gave was that the cat's ears looked detached from her head. Someone still has to look at the game and play it.

\- Canvas performance on Android is still in progress. I'm still chasing a steady 60 fps on my own phone.



It's free to play, with ads and in-app purchases: Remove Ads and a cosmetic Extras pack. Nothing you can buy speeds up the game.



Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=rs.dvsoftware.purrconomy](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=rs.dvsoftware.purrconomy)

More about the game: [https://dvsoftware.rs/purrconomy](https://dvsoftware.rs/purrconomy)



Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
